frozen_candidate_root_contribution: nkr contributes the negative pole of recognition/acknowledgment: to place or find something OUTSIDE the domain of the recognized/owned. It runs as one graded derivational family — (a) perceptual failure-to-recognize, X is unfamiliar/strange (nakira 11:70; munkirun 12:58; munkarun 'strangers' 15:62, 51:25; causative nakkiru 'render unrecognizable' 27:41); (b) volitional withholding-of-acknowledgment of the KNOWN, i.e. disavow/repudiate/deny (yunkiru/tunkirun 13:36, 16:83, 40:81; munkirun/munkira 21:50, 23:69, 16:22); and (c) the nominalized 'that which is (rightly) not acknowledged' = al-munkar, the reprehensible/disavowed (the al-maʿruf/al-munkar frame). It is welded Quran-internally by direct ع ر ف (ʿrf) antonymy in the same clause/verse (16:83 yaʿrifuna...thumma yunkirunaha; 12:58 faʿarafahum wa-hum lahu munkirun; 23:69; 22:72 taʿrifu...al-munkar) and by al-maʿruf (itself the ʿrf passive participle) standing opposite al-munkar. It does NOT by itself encode severity, direness, or sensory repugnance.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root's demonstrated centre is 'not-recognizing / refusing-to-acknowledge', the exact opposite of ʿrf ('to recognize'). The Quran stages the two together in single verses: they recognize God's favour, then disavow it (16:83); Joseph recognized his brothers while they did not recognize him (12:58); you recognize the munkar on the deniers' faces (22:72). From this one negative-recognition idea come the strangers who are 'not recognized' (15:62, 51:25), the disguised throne 'made unrecognizable' (27:41), the deniers of the signs (40:81), and, nominalized, al-munkar = 'the not-acknowledged-as-good' = the reprehensible (the standing maʿruf/munkar pairing). One class does NOT reduce to this: the adjective nukr/nukur and the elative ankar mean 'dreadful/dire/harsh/repugnant' (a dire punishment 18:87, 65:8; a dreadful thing 54:6; the donkey's bray as the most jarring of sounds 31:19) — an evaluative sense that pushes away from recognition.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: nkr does NOT entail: (1) ignorance / lack of information — in 16:83 and 40:81 the referents fully know (yaʿrifuna / signs shown) and STILL do nkr; nkr is refusal-to-acknowledge, independent of truth-value. (2) fear — 11:70 lists nakirahum and awjasa khifatan as two distinct reactions. (3) inherent moral fault — 11:70, 12:58, 15:62, 51:25 are morally neutral non-recognition; 'strangers' (munkarun) are not blamed. (4) identity with kufr — 16:83 sets yunkiruna apart from wa-aktharuhumu-l-kafirun. (5) identity with kdhb (declare-false) — 58:2 lists munkaran AND zuran as two things; 34:45/67:18 place kadhdhabu then God's nakir. (6) mere novelty — al-munkar in the maʿruf/munkar frame is the reprehensible-disavowed, not the epistemically new; it is an objective category that can be enjoined (9:67), committed (29:29, 5:79 faʿaluhu) and spoken (58:2). CRUCIALLY nkr does NOT by itself mean 'severe/dreadful/repugnant': that value is carried only by the lexicalized ADJ nukr/ankar class and does not transfer to the recognition core.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 31:19 (inna ankara l-aswati la-sawtu l-hamir, 'the most nkr of sounds is the braying of donkeys') does not merely lack recognition-support — it CONTRADICTS a non-recognition nucleus: a donkey's bray is maximally familiar/recognized, yet it is graded the MOST nkr, because the operative sense is 'disagreeable/harsh/repugnant', a value orthogonal to recognition. Reinforcing: in 65:8 nukr stands in internal parallel with an intensity adjective (hisaban shadidan ... adhaban nukran), glossing nukr toward severity, not non-recognition; and 18:87 / 54:6 apply nukr to a real, decreed punishment and to the Reckoning — things that are not 'unrecognized' but 'dire/dreadful'. This evaluative ADJ/elative class is a coherent, internally-supported resistant sub-class and is the ceiling-capping evidence.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two competitors. (i) SPLITTER: two poles the Quran never internally welds — a recognition/acknowledgment pole (Clusters 1-3, incl. al-munkar = the-disavowed) and a repugnance/severity pole (nukr/ankar). Each beats the other on its own turf: the recognition nucleus cannot generate 31:19/65:8, while a repugnance nucleus cannot generate the pure passive 'qawmun munkarun' (15:62, 51:25) or nakira at 11:70. This is not adopted as the whole-root verdict because the recognition core IS internally welded (in-clause ʿrf antonymy; munkirun spans neutral 12:58 to loaded 21:50 with no morphological break; al-munkar 'wrong' is the SAME passive participle as munkarun 'strangers'); but the splitter retains decisive force for the evaluative class, which is therefore held out as RESISTANT rather than forced into unity. (ii) VALUATION CORE 'to reject/deny/find-objectionable': elegant for Clusters 2-4 but fails the cognitive cases (Abraham does not 'reject' guests 11:70; a throne is 'disguised' not 'rejected' 27:41; guests are 'unfamiliar' not 'rejected' 15:62/51:25), so 'reject' is a contextual specialization of the recognition-negation core, not the core itself.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converge on ONE demonstrated nucleus (negative pole of recognition/acknowledgment) with the al-munkar deontic nominal bridged to it, and on ONE resistant class (evaluative nukr/ankar). The core is broad, cross-form (V, V(II) causative, V(IV), both participles, and the nominal), distinctive, and adversarially clean where it counts: ʿrf-antonymy appears in the same clause/verse repeatedly. That alone would push toward STRONG. Two contract conditions force the ceiling down to MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, and BOTH hold simultaneously: (1) a lexicalized nominal sub-class — al-munkar reified into an enjoinable/committable objective moral category (9:67 yaʾmuruna bi-l-munkar; 29:29; 5:79 faʿaluhu; 58:2), frequency-dominant; and (2) MATERIAL RESISTANCE — the nukr/ankar 'dreadful/dire/harsh' class (18:87, 54:6, 65:8, 31:19) that 31:19 and 65:8 push actively away from the recognition axis with no Quran-internal ʿrf/munkar bridge. STRONG requires 'no coherent resistant sub-class'; that condition fails. The classes are not fully unbridged homonyms (so not UNRESOLVED): the recognition-to-reprehensible development is internally proven by the shared munkar participle. Hence PREFERRED single nucleus, REPRESENTATIVE of Clusters 1-3 (~33/37), MODERATE, with the evaluative class explicitly held RESISTANT.

clusters.classification_rationale: Bridged to C1 by (a) the standing al-maʿruf/al-munkar antonym frame, where al-maʿruf is the ʿrf passive participle and al-munkar the nkr passive participle (same pattern as munkarun 'strangers' in C1), and (b) 22:72 taʿrifu fi wujuhi...al-munkar, placing ʿrf and munkar in one clause. 18:74 shayʾan nukran ('you have done a monstrous thing', the slain boy) bridges the ADJ nukr to munkar-as-reprehensible/to-be-disavowed, linking C2 to the evaluative C4.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Lexicalized/reified: enjoined by hypocrites/Satan (9:67, 24:21), committed (29:29, 5:79 faʿaluhu), spoken (58:2 munkaran mina-l-qawl wa-zuran). It is co-listed as DISTINCT from fahshaʾ and baghy (16:90), so it is the superordinate 'disavowed', not 'gross indecency'. Its frozen nominal status is a strength-capping lexicalization.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: nakir = repudiation/disowning enacted or the power thereof — God's reciprocal repudiation of the deniers (refrain fa-kayfa kana nakiri), and 'you have no nakir' = no power of disavowal/refusal on the Day (42:47, paired with 'no refuge').
clusters.classification_rationale: Bridged to the volitional pole of C1/C2: those who did nkr (withheld acknowledgment) receive God's nkr; 34:45/67:18/22:44 pair kadhdhabu with the ensuing nakiri, and 42:47 pairs it with maljaʾ. It stays on the disavowal/repudiation axis rather than the recognition-perception axis.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Weakly resistant drift toward 'retributive consequence' in the refrain (a product of repudiation rather than the process), but bridgeable and juxtaposed to human denial, so held CONSISTENT with the note recorded.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Evaluative/affective 'dreadful, dire, harsh, repugnant' (ADJ nukr/nukur; elative ankar) — a value orthogonal to recognition.
clusters.classification_rationale: Materially resists the recognition nucleus: (i) never co-occurs with ع ر ف; (ii) 65:8 internally parallels nukr with shadid (severity); (iii) 31:19 grades a MAXIMALLY FAMILIAR object (a donkey's bray) as MOST nkr, contradicting the prediction that the least-recognized is most-nkr; (iv) 18:87/54:6 apply it to a real decreed punishment and the Reckoning, which are not 'unrecognized'. The 'unheard-of -> dreadful' bridge is inferential and Quran-internally unclosed. A lexicalized/evaluative sub-class, not a contextual shade.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 18:74 (nukr = monstrous deed) is the bridge case, assigned to C2 because it reads as 'reprehensible/to-be-disavowed'; the remaining four carry only the severity/repugnance value and are held RESISTANT.

reconciliation.rationale: Lenses A and B show 18:74 bridges cleanly to munkar = 'a thing to be disavowed / reprehensible deed' (the killing of the boy), i.e. the same disavowed-reprehensible sense as al-munkar. It therefore belongs in C2 as the bridge between the deontic nominal and the evaluative class, not in the resistant class.
A donkey's bray is maximally familiar yet graded most-nkr; the sense is sensory 'harsh/repugnant', orthogonal to recognition, and there is no ʿrf/munkar bridge. Held RESISTANT with C4.

nakir reciprocates human disavowal (kadhdhabu -> fa-kayfa kana nakiri) and pairs with maljaʾ at 42:47; it remains on the repudiation/disavowal pole and is bridged to the volitional core, so CONSISTENT with the drift recorded in the cluster note.

adversarial_verification.notes: The recognition-negation core is distinctive (in-clause ʿrf antonymy) and falsifiable, and it survives adversarial pressure across C1-C3. However the evaluative nukr/ankar class (C4) materially resists and is not welded Quran-internally, so a formal falsification returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed; the resistant occurrences are recorded rather than a PASSED verdict asserted.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversarial C) converged on one recognition-negation nucleus plus the same resistant evaluative sub-class; C's strongest counterexample (31:19) and severity parallel (65:8) are adopted as the ceiling-capping evidence.
candidate_root_contribution: nkr contributes the negative pole of recognition/acknowledgment: to place or find something OUTSIDE the domain of the recognized/owned. It runs as one graded derivational family — (a) perceptual failure-to-recognize, X is unfamiliar/strange (nakira 11:70; munkirun 12:58; munkarun 'strangers' 15:62, 51:25; causative nakkiru 'render unrecognizable' 27:41); (b) volitional withholding-of-acknowledgment of the KNOWN, i.e. disavow/repudiate/deny (yunkiru/tunkirun 13:36, 16:83, 40:81; munkirun/munkira 21:50, 23:69, 16:22); and (c) the nominalized 'that which is (rightly) not acknowledged' = al-munkar, the reprehensible/disavowed (the al-maʿruf/al-munkar frame). It is welded Quran-internally by direct ع ر ف (ʿrf) antonymy in the same clause/verse (16:83 yaʿrifuna...thumma yunkirunaha; 12:58 faʿarafahum wa-hum lahu munkirun; 23:69; 22:72 taʿrifu...al-munkar) and by al-maʿruf (itself the ʿrf passive participle) standing opposite al-munkar. It does NOT by itself encode severity, direness, or sensory repugnance.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 37/37 occurrences read with QAC morphology and Tanzil verse_text; the recognition core rests on directly attested ʿrf/nkr co-text (16:83, 12:58, 23:69, 22:72), the neutral passives 'qawmun munkarun' (15:62, 51:25), the causative 27:41, and the maʿruf/munkar frame.
layer_attribution.derivation: One derivational family spans Form I (nakira), Form II causative (nakkiru), Form IV verb (yunkiru/tunkirun), Form IV active participle (munkir-/munkira), Form IV passive participle (munkar-/al-munkar), the noun nakir, and the ADJ/elative nukr/nukur/ankar.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: al-munkar (C2) is a lexicalized/reified deontic nominal (enjoinable 9:67, committable 29:29/5:79, sayable 58:2); nukr/ankar (C4) is a lexicalized evaluative ADJ/elative — both lexicalizations cap the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative/contextual colour (Abraham's wariness 11:70, Joseph's brothers 12:58, hypocrites vs believers in the maʿruf/munkar contrast, God's retribution refrain) frames the tokens but is NOT elevated into the root claim; the root claim is confined to the recognition-negation semantics.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Contested tokens reconciled: 18:74 moved from resistant (C's Class 4) to CONSISTENT bridge in C2 (reprehensible/disavowed); 31:19 moved from possible-repudiation to RESISTANT evaluative; the nakir refrain kept CONSISTENT with a recorded drift note.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The evaluative nukr/ankar sense (18:87, 54:6, 65:8, 31:19) remains an unbridged resistant sub-class — 'dreadful/dire/harsh/repugnant' — that the recognition nucleus does not Quran-internally generate; it is held out rather than forced into unity, and is the reason the root is REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE, not STRONG.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A recognition/acknowledgment-negation reading fails on a CORE verbal or participial occurrence — an occurrence where nakira/yunkiru/munkir/munkar cannot mean 'fail-to-recognize / withhold-acknowledgment / the-not-acknowledged' and instead demands a pure severity or sensory-repugnance value, or where al-munkar in the maʿruf/munkar frame cannot be construed as 'the disavowed / not-acknowledged-as-good'.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test each core occurrence against (a) the in-clause ʿ-r-f antonymy (16:83, 12:58, 23:69, 22:72) and (b) the al-maʿruf/al-munkar substitution; require that 'withhold/lack recognition' or 'the disavowed' fits the surface without importing 'severe/dreadful'.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude the already-conceded resistant ADJ/elative class (18:87, 54:6, 65:8, 31:19) and do not read its severity value back into the core; separate co-text kufr (16:83) and kdhb (34:45, 67:18, 58:2) from nkr's own contribution; do not let al-munkar's frozen nominal status be mistaken for a distinct semantics.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a core occurrence genuinely resists the recognition-negation reading, the nucleus ceases to be representative across Clusters 1-3 and the result must drop to WEAK or be re-partitioned as an UNRESOLVED multi-class root.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal bridge is demonstrated that welds the evaluative nukr/ankar class (18:87, 54:6, 65:8, 31:19) to the recognition nucleus — e.g. an occurrence pairing nukr/ankar with ʿ-r-f or with munkar-as-disavowed — re-evaluate Cluster 4 from RESISTANT toward CONSISTENT.

If the nakir class (22:44, 34:45, 35:26, 67:18, 42:47) is shown to drift decisively to 'retributive consequence' detached from the repudiation/disavowal pole, reopen Cluster 3's CONSISTENT disposition.

If al-munkar in the maʿruf/munkar frame is shown to be a frozen homonym with no live 'not-acknowledged' derivation despite the shared passive participle munkarun 'strangers' (15:62, 51:25), reconsider whether Cluster 2 truly bridges to Cluster 1.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The recognition-negation core is distinctive (in-clause ʿrf antonymy) and falsifiable, and it survives adversarial pressure across C1-C3. However the evaluative nukr/ankar class (C4) materially resists and is not welded Quran-internally, so a formal falsification returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed; the resistant occurrences are recorded rather than a PASSED verdict asserted.
